{:db/id 17592186172131 :knowledge-point/canonical-example {:db/id 17592186171711 :question/id #uuid "fce43073-3f48-5e12-a5c0-ecef3a31a57a" :question/math-academy-id "e-12346" :question/problem "Evaluate the surface integral 

$$
\iint\limits_{S} (x-y)\: \textrm{d}S,
$$

where the parametric surface $S$ is defined by the equations

$$
x = u+v, \qquad 
y = u-v, \qquad 
z = v
$$

for $0 \leq u \leq 3$ and $0 \leq v \leq 3.$" :question/worked-solution "For a surface $S$ with parametrization $\mathbf{r}(u,v)$ for $(u,v)\in D,$ the surface integral of a scalar function $f$ over $S$ is given by

$$
\iint\limits_S f(x,y,z) \, \textrm{d}S 
=
\iint\limits_D f(\mathbf{r}(u,v)) \left\|  \mathbf{r}'_u \times \mathbf{r}'_v \right\|  \text{d}A.
$$

In vector form, our surface has the equation 

$$
\mathbf{r}(u,v) = \left\langle u+v, \: u-v, \: v\right\rangle.
$$

We first compute the tangent vectors to the grid curves:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\mathbf{r}}_{u}^{'} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂u},\hspace{0.222em}\frac{∂y}{∂u},\hspace{0.222em}\frac{∂z}{∂u}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂u}(u+v),\hspace{0.222em}\frac{∂}{∂u}(u-v),\hspace{0.222em}\frac{∂}{∂u}(v)⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\hspace{0.222em}1,\hspace{0.222em}0⟩ \\ {\mathbf{r}}_{v}^{'} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂v},\hspace{0.222em}\frac{∂y}{∂v},\hspace{0.222em}\frac{∂z}{∂v}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂v}(u+v),\hspace{0.222em}\frac{∂}{∂v}(u-v),\hspace{0.222em}\frac{∂}{∂v}(v)⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\hspace{0.222em}-1,\hspace{0.222em}1⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Now, the fundamental vector product is

$$
\begin{aligned}{\mathbf{r}}_{u}^{'}\times {\mathbf{r}}_{v}^{'} & =\begin{vmatrix}\mathbf{i} & \mathbf{j} & \mathbf{k} \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & -1 & 1\end{vmatrix} \\  & =⟨\begin{vmatrix}1 & 0 \\ -1 & 1\end{vmatrix},\hspace{0.222em}-\begin{vmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1\end{vmatrix},\hspace{0.222em}\begin{vmatrix}1 & 1 \\ 1 & -1\end{vmatrix}⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\hspace{0.222em}-1,\hspace{0.222em}-2⟩,\end{aligned}
$$

and 

$$
\begin{aligned}‖{\mathbf{r}}_{u}^{'}\times {\mathbf{r}}_{v}^{'}‖ & =‖⟨1,\hspace{0.222em}-1,\hspace{0.222em}-2⟩‖ \\  & =\sqrt{{1}^{2}+(-1)^{2}+(-2)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1+1+4} \\  & =\sqrt{6}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we substitute the coordinate expressions of $\mathbf{r}(u,v)$ into $f(x,y,z){:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(\mathbf{r}(u,v)) & =x-y\hspace{0.167em}{|}_{x=u+v\,y=u-v\,z=v} \\  & =(u+v)-(u-v) \\  & =2v\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, if we denote 

$$
D = \{ (u,v) \: : \: 0 \leq u \leq 3, \: 0 \leq v \leq 3\},
$$

our surface integral can be written as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{S}(x-y)\hspace{0.222em}\text{d}S & ={∬}_{D}f(\mathbf{r}(u,v))‖{\mathbf{r}}_{u}^{'}\times {\mathbf{r}}_{v}^{'}‖\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\hspace{0.167em}2v\sqrt{6}\hspace{0.222em}\text{d}A \\  & =\sqrt{6}{∬}_{D}\hspace{0.167em}2v\hspace{0.222em}\text{d}A \\  & =\sqrt{6}{\int }_{0}^{3}2v\hspace{0.222em}\text{d}v\cdot {\int }_{0}^{3}1\hspace{0.222em}\text{d}u \\  & =\sqrt{6}\cdot [{v}^{2}]_{0}^{3}\cdot [u]_{0}^{3} \\  & =\sqrt{6}\cdot 9\cdot 3 \\  & =27\sqrt{6}.\end{aligned}
$$"} :knowledge-point/id #uuid "4b529430-3406-506c-b67d-c067dfee44d5" :knowledge-point/level-coverage [{:db/ident :question.difficulty/hard} {:db/ident :question.difficulty/moderate}] :knowledge-point/question-generator {:db/id 17592186540197 :question-generator/id #uuid "c3e9b683-f86b-5dd8-a733-33d6da415377" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186172131.py"} :knowledge-point/questions [{:db/id 17592186172377 :question/answer-fields [{:answer-field/choices [{:answer/id #uuid "11345332-1583-5403-b382-1f7db9544110" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "\sqrt{70}" :db/id 17592186414431} {:answer/id #uuid "6ed83581-5e32-5a0e-8a25-178bb99cade4" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "36\sqrt{70}" :db/id 17592186414439} {:answer/id #uuid "7d00c43b-e899-573d-afa8-6b12ead91cda" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "12\sqrt{70}" :db/id 17592186414440} {:answer/id #uuid "bc8100ab-c718-514d-8f3c-f28643c256a5" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "2\sqrt{70}" :db/id 17592186414447} {:answer/id #uuid "d24b3aff-8b91-5bf0-8ab1-f276e0780c98" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "4\sqrt{70}" :db/id 17592186414450}] :answer-field/correct {:answer/id #uuid "7d00c43b-e899-573d-afa8-6b12ead91cda" :answer/type {:db/ident :answer.type/math} :answer/value "12\sqrt{70}" :db/id 17592186414440} :answer-field/id #uuid "be382d30-f02e-5329-bcf7-16808280a34b" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type {:db/ident :answer-field.type/radio} :db/id 17592186414459}] :question/difficulty {:db/ident :question.difficulty/moderate} :question/id #uuid "82d5af65-9d79-5b70-b0f6-be91c0743951" :question/math-academy-id "q-160834" :question/problem "Evaluate the surface integral

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}_{u}^{′} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂u},\,\frac{∂y}{∂u},\,\frac{∂z}{∂u}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂u}(u),\,\frac{∂}{∂u}(v),\,\frac{∂}{∂u}(6-3u-2v)⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\,0,\,-3⟩ \\ {r}_{v}^{′} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂v},\,\frac{∂y}{∂v},\,\frac{∂z}{∂v}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂v}(u),\,\frac{∂}{∂v}(v),\,\frac{∂}{∂v}(6-3u-2v)⟩ \\  & =⟨0,\,1,\,-2⟩\end{aligned}

$$

$$

$$

$$
\mathbf{r}(x,\theta )=⟨x,\hspace{0.222em}2{x}^{2}\operatorname{cos}\theta ,\hspace{0.222em}2{x}^{2}\operatorname{sin}\theta ⟩,\hspace{1em}x\in [0,1],\hspace{1em}\theta \in [0,2\pi ),

and the norm of the fundamental vector product is

$$
‖{\mathbf{r}}_{x}^{'}\times {\mathbf{r}}_{\theta }^{'}‖=2{x}^{2}\sqrt{16{x}^{2}+1}.

$$

$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(\mathbf{r}(u,v)) & ={x}^{2}-2yz\hspace{0.167em}{|}_{x=u+v\,y=u\,z=v} \\  & =(u+v)^{2}-2uv \\  & ={u}^{2}+{v}^{2}\end{aligned}

$$
